verdict.rationale: n8n documents a built-in Credentials system with per-integration credential types (e.g. Asana, Atlassian, GitHub), which supports storing connection credentials centrally in the product. Sharing credentials with a team and controlling which users can use which credential are not documented; the only related evidence is generic role-based access and admin roles, which are not credential-level controls. Missing for 10: documented credential sharing with team members or projects, per-credential usage permissions, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the credential store.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: Self-host or deploy securely with role-based access, audit trails, and support for sensitive data
